verdicts.quote: Each reminder step is an integer number of days relative to the invoice's due date (negative = before, 0 = on, positive = after). The default schedule is 0, 7, 14 and 30.
Once an invoice is paid in full, void, written off, or has a balance of 0.00 or less (fully paid, credited or refunded), no further reminder is sent for it
verdicts.missing: Whether an invoice on a payment plan stops reminders, and whether a disputed invoice stops automatically (the spec only offers a manual per-invoice pause, U-6).

verdicts.quote: For a partially paid invoice the reminder states the outstanding balance (total minus payments and credits), not the original total.
Deliberately not provided: ... pausing per customer, ... a customer-facing unsubscribe link
verdicts.missing: Whether an existing do-not-contact, paused or unsubscribed flag on the customer is honoured, and whether billing reminders are exempt from a marketing opt-out.

verdicts.quote: Whatever happens — two evaluations at the same time, an evaluation run twice, a restart, a retry — no recipient receives more than one email for the same invoice and offset.
The invoice state is checked immediately before each email is handed to the delivery provider; a payment, void, pause or turning off recorded before that check prevents the send
retried to that recipient at an evaluation at least 60 minutes later, up to 3 attempts in total per recipient and step; after the third failure the recipient's result is "error"
verdicts.missing: Retry and outage (C-82) are covered, but nothing escalates to or alerts a person when sending keeps failing; operators must find failures themselves in the C-60 list.

verdicts.quote: Emails are handed to the delivery provider at no more than 10 per second by default ... the remaining sends are delayed, not dropped
Only invoices that have a step whose date is within the last 3 days (or today) receive a reminder, one email per invoice. An invoice 20 days overdue receives nothing that day
sent at the first evaluation at or after the send time (default 09:00) on the step's date in the business time zone ... sent on its date even if it is a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday
The outstanding balance is shown with its ISO currency code and with the currency's standard number of decimal places (2 for USD and EUR, 0 for JPY)
After a permanent bounce or a rejection ... later steps of that invoice show that address as "suppressed"; ... If an eligible step has no recipient, it stays pending with the reason "no recipient"
Recipients are the billing email addresses listed on the invoice. If it lists none, the customer's default billing email ... At most 5 recipients

For every step the invoice shows: offset, scheduled date, outcome (pending, sent, skipped, failed, outcome unknown), the reason for skipped/failed, the time of the last attempt, and per recipient address and result
the invoice number; the outstanding balance with its currency code; the due date; ... the invoice's payment link where it has one, otherwise the payment-instructions text
verdicts.missing: Whether the payment link can expire and what the reminder does if it has.

verdicts.quote: Turning on/off, editing settings and pausing/resuming an invoice are refused for users without the permission to manage reminders; ... only administrators of the account hold the permission
Deliberately not provided: sending a reminder on demand, pausing per customer
verdicts.missing: Global off (C-17), per-customer and manual resend are decided, but no preview or dry-run of what will be sent exists in production; only non-production shows would-be content (C-43).

verdicts.quote: It also shows the next scheduled step and its date. ... An operator can list reminder steps across all invoices filtered by step outcome
A step more than 3 days past is not sent and is recorded as skipped with the reason "window expired"
Reminders do not modify an invoice's status, amounts, due date or payments. ... Creating invoices, recording payments and voiding work as without the feature
